title: Reverse Layup Both Hands
description: Players practise the reverse layup from both sides of the rim, using the backboard and body control to finish away from help defense.

content.objective: Finish a reverse layup under control using either hand depending on the approach side.
content.setup: Players start at the block with a ball, approaching from a 45-degree angle.
instructions: Drive baseline-side under the rim at a controlled speed.
Spin the body so the back faces the defender's side as you go under the rim.
Finish off the backboard with the hand away from where a defender would be.
Repeat from the opposite side using the other hand.
coachingPoints: Keep the ball high and away from the defender's side throughout.
Use a soft touch off the glass rather than forcing the ball in.
Land balanced, ready to box out for a potential rebound.
commonMistakes: Spinning too early, exposing the ball to the defender.
Rushing the touch instead of using the backboard softly.
Rushing the last two steps instead of gathering under control.
content.safety: Only one player under the basket at a time.
